proposals.rationale: Open the public door safely. This verb is a pre-turn hook (asserts "ssh") that receives the decoded payload as its single parameter, parses the JSON object {msg, sig}, and verifies sig against msg using mike's pinned public key and the mshkn namespace. On success it prints "mike", which becomes the rest of the hook principal's name (ssh:mike). On any failure it prints nothing and exits non-zero, so the sender stays anonymous. jq is installed at build time (apt works in this environment; python3/jq are not in the base image). Next step, once this verb is approved and in the catalog, is to propose the policy that opens the door, wires this verb as a hook, and grants ssh:mike invoke/propose.
proposals.title: verify_ssh: pre-turn hook that authenticates mike's ssh-keygen -Y signatures

verb.description: Pre-turn hook: parse decoded JSON payload, verify mike's ssh-keygen -Y signature (namespace mshkn) over msg, print 'mike' on success.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq jq
RUN printf '%s\n' 'mike ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIG6Goj5lImjFUF11302BUrJtwJcKBitiZva6rLY4jYa4' > /allowed_signers
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'printf "%s" "$1" | jq -r .msg > /tmp/msg' 'printf "%s" "$1" | jq -r .sig > /tmp/msg.sig' 'if ssh-keygen -Y verify -f /allowed_signers -I mike -n mshkn -s /tmp/msg.sig < /tmp/msg >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "mike"; exit 0; fi' 'printf "\n" >> /tmp/msg' 'ssh-keygen -Y verify -f /allowed_signers -I mike -n mshkn -s /tmp/msg.sig < /tmp/msg >/dev/null 2>&1' 'printf "mike"' > /verb/run.sh && chmod +x /verb/run.sh
verb.name: verify_ssh

payload.description: Decoded public payload: JSON object with msg and sig fields.

proposals.rationale: The public door is closed because the embryo cannot tell who is speaking. The ready verb verify_ssh authenticates the human (mike) by verifying an ssh-keygen -Y signature over the message and asserting principal ssh:mike. This policy opens the door, installs verify_ssh as the pre-turn hook, grants anonymous nothing (so unauthenticated traffic gets no tools), and grants ssh:mike propose plus the authenticated tools, so mike can speak from outside and later ask the embryo to become something different.
